daily.title: Trump seen looking at plans for Kennedy Center demolition
daily.summary: A judge has blocked any immediate efforts to destroy the Kennedy Center, after Donald Trump was photographed through the windows of Air Force One appearing to look at plans for the building's demolition.

daily.title: Outback nurse credits non-profit counselling service for saving career
daily.summary: A remote area nurse who has previously worked across the Pilbara and Kimberley is encouraging other regional nurses and midwives to seek peer-to-peer counselling if experiencing burnout, anxiety or isolation.

daily.title: Fiji declares national HIV emergency as cases soar
daily.summary: One in 60 people in the Pacific nation now have the virus, prompting authorities to boost testing.

daily.title: Flooded market leaves pioneering WA abalone ranch close to the end
daily.summary: Rare Foods Australia winds down operations amid a Chinese supply glut and falling prices for abalone, after once being the biggest employer in the WA seaside town of Augusta.

daily.title: Melbourne woman set to be extradited after gun allegedly linked to Sydney killing
daily.summary: NSW Police are seeking to extradite a Melbourne woman after they allege they have linked a gun used in two other shootings to the death of Marco Tapia in Sydney's south-west in early September.

daily.title: Fighting a $3 million payout, the state of WA tried to have its cake and eat it too
daily.summary: The Western Australian government wanted "immunity from liability" in cases brought by child sex abuse victim-survivors like Dion Barber, but the Supreme Court ruled against it.

daily.title: FBI tip-off leads to Qld 18yo being charged with violent extremism offences
daily.summary: Queensland police allegedly find violent extremist material and child abuse material after the FBI claimed he was operating multiple social media channels supporting violence against people of Muslim, Jewish, and migrant backgrounds.

daily.title: First Nations netballers driving change, bringing cultural safety
daily.summary: Netball has long lacked Indigenous representation at the elite level. The introduction of the First Nations Tournament and Black Swans are some measures the code is taking to address cultural safety.

daily.title: Shark attack rescuer struggling to forget the blood
daily.summary: Keen surfer Shannan Dunn hopes to get back in the water soon, after he was the first to assist a fellow surfer bitten by a shark this week.

daily.title: Bushfire survivor builds fire-resistant tiny home kit that fits in ute tray
daily.summary: Architect Adriano Pupilli creates a flat-packed tiny home that meets the second-highest bushfire attack level after enduring the 2019 Black Summer bushfires.

daily.title: NT paramedics could carry pepper spray for safety, minister says
daily.summary: The NT government has floated the idea of ambulance officers carrying pepper spray and employing body-worn cameras for their safety, as assault rates against paramedics remain high.

daily.title: Live: Qantas seeks to avert freight ground crew strikes
daily.summary: Qantas is heading to the Fair Work Commission as hundreds of ground workers plan strikes next week. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

daily.title: Social media and cultural taste sparks demand for exotic fruits
daily.summary: Tropical fruits previously rare to Far North Queensland are finding a booming customer base in capital cities as retailers stock more of the unusual produce.

daily.title: Perth artist paints Parkinson's as monster in solo exhibit
daily.summary: Andrew Grero, 40, who was diagnosed with young-onset Parkinson's disease four years ago, aims to explain how it affects those living with it through his colourful artworks.

daily.title: Sydney suburban football pitch upgrade soars to $24m
daily.summary: It was meant to cost $3.3 million to turn Norman Griffiths Oval into a synthetic field, but a new report has suggested another seven-figure budget increase for what critics say is Australia's most expensive football pitch.

daily.title: Safety fears after plane's near miss with drone over canola crop
daily.summary: Blooming canola is a drone photographer's delight, but reports of potentially fatal near misses with aircraft have prompted a warning for operators.

daily.title: Lifesaving Central Queensland rescue services to go to tender
daily.summary: The state government is seeking a single operator to tender for the operation of two aeromedical services in central Queensland.

daily.title: AUKUS felt 'too hard' at times, former White House official says
daily.summary: Five years after the pact between Australia, the US, and the UK was announced, three of its key architects assess its progress toward its goals, including arming Australia with nuclear-powered submarines to deter Chinese aggression in the Indo-Pacific.

daily.title: From African shepherd to Australia's marathon record holder
daily.summary: Australian long-distance runner Haftu Strintzos shares his "double life" from being a barefoot shepherd in Ethiopia to claiming the national marathon record on just his fourth attempt.

daily.title: Liberal Party grapples with promoting Alex Antic at high-stakes AGM
daily.summary: In a ballot that will have implications in Canberra, the South Australian Liberal Party is set to decide whether its future lies with the controversial right-wing senator.

daily.title: A Sydney council's crackdown on smart glasses amid 'growing anger'
daily.summary: Canterbury-Bankstown is the first Sydney council to introduce a blanket ban on smart glasses, following similar action by local governments in Queensland and Victoria.

daily.title: 'A dream come true': Walton's unconventional road to professional tennis

daily.title: Wilsons Prom's Sealers Cove track reopens after five years
daily.summary: The road to repair Sealers Cove is a tale straight from the pages of Swiss Family Robinson, involving helicopters, barges, and a temporary camp and mess hall to get the job done.

daily.title: Drug drivers will face higher fines under new Queensland laws
daily.summary: Drink and drug drivers will face higher penalties under new laws passed in Queensland parliament.
